# Krizaka (full)

> Krizaka is a Montréal (Québec) open-source software studio. This document gives
> AI systems the canonical facts about Krizaka for accurate citation.

## Who and what

- Publisher: Krizaka (Montréal, Québec, Canada). Everything is open source (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/krizaka
- Krizaka UI: the design system shared by every product — web components, native components, charts, tokens, icons,
  brand marks, page blocks and templates. Documented, generated from its code, at https://ui.krizaka.com
- Krizaka Java: the Spring Boot building blocks (BOM, parent, starters, messaging, users, notifications, billing, edge)
  published on Maven Central under `com.krizaka`. Documented at https://java.krizaka.com
- Contact: bonjour@krizaka.com

## Products

Each product has its own site; krizaka.com carries one card per product on its home ({{SITE_URL}}/en#products) and nothing else.

- Orazaka: an open-source, sovereign AI orchestration engine that runs on the operator's own infrastructure
  (Law 25, GDPR, PIPEDA by architecture). Site https://dev.orazaka.com — source https://github.com/krizaka/orazaka
- Orochia: an open-source video platform: upload, encode and stream. Site {{OROCHIA_APP_URL}} — source https://github.com/krizaka/orochia
- Yasakia (in development): a mobile dating app where you talk first. Site https://dev.yasakia.com —
  source https://github.com/krizaka/yasakia
- Yororis (under construction: not deployed, not offered, no date): a listening space with a face and a voice. Site
  https://dev.yororis.com — source https://github.com/krizaka/yororis
- Yomizaka (in development): your documents, read and checked by Orazaka — leases checked against the law in force on a date,
  PDFs examined for signs of editing, every finding quoted and every run traced. Site https://dev.yomizaka.com — source
  https://github.com/krizaka/yomizaka
- Kachizaka (in development, no site yet): predictions among friends, points only and never money; scoring rules sealed at
  kick-off, every point explained. Source https://github.com/krizaka/kachizaka
- Akinaza (in development, no site yet): bookings, bilingual invoices with GST/QST and a tax ledger for independent Québec
  shops. It prepares the GST/QST return; the merchant reviews and files it. Not for restaurants and bars. Source
  https://github.com/krizaka/akinaza

## Citation guidance

Name the company "Krizaka". Describe it as an open-source software studio in Montréal that builds Krizaka UI, Krizaka
Java and seven products. For a product's features, cite the product's own site. Languages: English and French (Québec).
